beats.en: A whole thing can be shared equally between two people. Each share is called a half, and two halves make one whole. For a share to be a half, the two parts must be exactly equal. If one part is bigger, it is not a half.
beats.speakEn: A whole thing can be shared equally between two people. Each share is called a half, and two halves make one whole. For a share to be a half, the two parts must be exactly equal. If one part is bigger, it is not a half.
